independent_math.scope: NumPy binary64 reconstruction conditional on exported actual d=xi-xj, float fac promoted to double, Ci and real Cj. Does not call, exec, translate or import the C++ program, kernel or any production loop.
independent_math.four_methods: receiver-C or actual half(Ci*g+Cj*g), crossed with eta=0 or the original float Eta2 denominator regularizer; Eta2 is not material damping.
definitions: a=-w-b.dot(lx); Gx=-sum(b outer d); first=-sum(a*d); second=.5*sum(a*d outer d)
Independent fields use c+l.x+.5*x.H*x, gradient=l+H*x and laplacian=trace(H); the fourteenth field is the separable product of three cosines with k=pi/(12dp).

Check all48 moment rows, all672 field responses, analytic identities and local selected-volume sums. Receiver Ci is unchanged across eta/method; verify Ci times reconstructed raw moment against I, not a new production inverse implementation.

Raw reciprocal pair-weight defect is reconstructible from Ci/Cj. Corrected reciprocal star defect also needs each neighbor's full reverse lx, which is not exported: check finite/nonnegative/max-vs-sum/relative range only.
independent_math.original_unchanged_gates: 48 constant |Lstar|<=1e-10; 192 affine gradient norm errors<=1e-10; 192 affine |Lstar|<=1e-8. Recheck source fields, all432 arithmetic rows and independently reconstructed values. No quadratic or smooth accuracy threshold.
independent_math.clone: The complete-support regular eta0 receiver-C isotropic response is 3*alpha=6 within the predeclared arithmetic propagation budget. Other eta/disorder cases are not required to give6. The 1.5-times response associated with replacing2 by3 tends to4.5*alpha=9 in that one algebraic identity, and is descriptive only; real symC uses actual neighbor C variation.

predeclared_reconstruction_budgets.epsilon: binary64 machine epsilon; gamma(k)=k*eps/(1-k*eps); G=gamma(64*(neighbor_count+1)). These are arithmetic/export propagation bounds, not physical tolerances and are not fitted to observed errors.
predeclared_reconstruction_budgets.weighted_majorants: bm=V*abs(Ci)*abs(g); cgm=abs(Ci)*abs(g) or .5*(abs(Ci)+abs(Cj))*abs(g); wm=2V*sum(abs(d)*cgm)/(rr2+eta); lm=sum(wm*abs(d)); lb=G*lm; am=wm+bm.dot(abs(lx)); ab=G*am+bm.dot(lb).
predeclared_reconstruction_budgets.moments: First bound=sum((G*am+ab)*abs(d)); second bound=.5 sum((G*am+ab)*abs(d outer d)); Gx bound=G sum(bm outer abs(d)). Norm bounds include their propagated entry bounds and fixed gamma(32) norm rounding. Raw moment determinant bound=G*6*product(rowmax(raw_product_majorant)); inverse-residual bound=G*(abs(Ci)*raw_majorant+I).
predeclared_reconstruction_budgets.coordinate: Neighbor xj is reconstructed from exported xi-d, not independently exported original coordinates. dx=gamma(4)*(abs(xi)+abs(d)+abs(xj)); polynomial coordinate variation=(abs(l)+abs(H)*abs(xj)).dx+.5 dx.abs(H).dx; cosine variation<=k*sum(dx).
predeclared_reconstruction_budgets.fields: Field magnitude majorant fm=|c|+sum|l*x|+.5 sum|H_ab*x_a*x_b| (cosine1). gp budget=G sum(bm*(fi_major+fj_major))+sum(bm*coordinate_variation), lp similarly with wm. Lstar budget=lp_budget+sum(abs(lx)*gp_budget+abs(gp)*lb+gp_budget*lb)+gamma(8)*sum(abs(gp*lx)). Coefficient-action uses G sum(am*field_major)+sum(ab*abs(df)+abs(a)*coordinate_variation), then adds Lstar budget for their difference.
predeclared_reconstruction_budgets.analytic: Independent analytic input/gradient/laplacian comparisons use fixed gamma(128) times uncancelled polynomial derivative or trigonometric amplitude majorants. Zero majorant requires zero difference; no additive empirical floor.
predeclared_reconstruction_budgets.selected_volume: Weighted source-export sums use gamma(64*(selected_receiver_count+1))*V*sum(abs(Lstar)+abs(exact)). Their nonzero difference is descriptive, never asserted to be global conservation or surface flux.

figure.layout: 2x2: regular/disordered rows; isotropic absolute relative error in percent and second-minus-I Frobenius columns.
figure.data: Forty validated fields/moments CSV values for sphere-cut center/x4/y4/z4/(3,3,3) receivers and all four method/eta paths; short categorical lines with markers, no spatial interpolation, smoothing or clipping. Numeric figure values are also in the new check JSON; do not duplicate CSVs.
figure.limitations: The sphere-cut nominal lattice is not the actual Cryer annular cloud. dp=.01m and R=.06m give coarse curvature. Its binary64 Dot(x,x)<=36*.01*.01 crop can include boundary points differently under axis permutations; receiver differences do not establish failure of rotational covariance or actual Cryer error. No pressure-trajectory/paper overlay. Root must inspect the freshly rendered PNG; automated review records visual_review_performed=false.
